preconditions: token, owner, spender, amount, expiration, chain, registry version, and code hashes match the immutable plan
current allowance is read from the same canonical snapshot
spender is the exact registry component and arbitrary approval calldata is rejected
postconditions: canonical Approval or Permit2 Approval event matches owner, token, spender, amount, and expiration
on-chain allowance is sufficient but does not exceed the frozen policy
USDT-style reset-to-zero path is separately reconciled
recoveryActions: read canonical allowance before any retry
skip when the exact bounded allowance is already confirmed
revoke or reset through a new approved plan when later execution is abandoned
enter reconciliation on receipt, provider, or allowance divergence

preconditions: unexpired quote digest matches tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn, minOut, route, router, spender, selector, fee policy, and registry version
router and spender runtime code hashes match at the execution block
simulation proves recipient, balance bounds, native value, and no forbidden target or selector
postconditions: canonical receipt and protocol events match the exact route
recipient output delta is at least minOutBaseUnit
input delta, fee, allowance, native value, and refund reconcile
recoveryActions: never reuse an expired quote
look up receipt and balance deltas before replacement or retry
requote into a new immutable step when no transaction was signed
retain assets and enter RECOVERABLE when a preceding approval succeeded

preconditions: platform, pool identity, tokens, ticks, amounts, min amounts, deadline, Helper owner, managers, Permit2, fee policy, and code hashes match the plan

mint recipient is exactly the wallet owner
postconditions: canonical manager and pool events identify the expected position
minted NFT owner is the wallet or increased tokenId remains owned by the wallet
liquidity delta, token deltas, fees, allowances, refund, and Helper dust reconcile
recoveryActions: scan canonical NFT and liquidity events before retry
if mint or increase confirmed, reconcile instead of resubmitting
if prior swap confirmed but position change did not, preserve assets and create a remaining-step plan
degrade Helper on owner, code, NFT, allowance, refund, or dust mismatch

position manager, recipient, amount maxima, snapshot, and code hash match the plan
collection cannot redirect proceeds away from the wallet

fees ledger records base-unit proceeds separately from new capital

treat an already-collected zero balance as reconciled only with canonical evidence
continue later reinvest steps without collecting twice

preconditions: percentage is 1 through 100 and resolves to a bounded liquidity delta
wallet ownership or exact NFT approval, ticks, min amounts, deadline, manager, and code hash match
collect and optional burn are distinct planned steps
postconditions: canonical decrease or modify-liquidity event matches tokenId and liquidity delta
remaining liquidity equals the reconciled expected value
proceeds are not considered available until collect and balance reconciliation complete

if decrease confirmed, continue at collect and never decrease twice

preconditions: refund token or native asset is part of the immutable plan
recipient is the Helper owner

Helper token and native balances are at or below each asset dust threshold
wrapped-native unwrap and native transfer events or balance deltas agree

do not refund twice when balance is already bounded
move Helper to residual when balance remains above threshold

preconditions: Helper is residual or superseded and owner plus runtime code hash reconcile
asset is registry-approved and current balance is positive
recipient is immutable owner and each wallet has a separate approved operation

allowance and NFT custody checks show no untracked authority or asset

retain per-asset partial results without replaying confirmed sweeps
keep Helper residual and block new funding on mismatch
